headline: The ANNOUNCER finally joins the show
lede: SMASH TV's finale now boards 24 cells wide like the rest of the arcade, and the host carries a new law: the camera never loses him. Along the way the autopilot learned to stop fleeing scenery.

notes.text: Room 9 runs the pan board (#2007's last gap closed). THE ANNOUNCER opens centre-stage and paces the middle of the live camera window — snap-and-flip containment keeps his crown fully framed even while the shot slides clamp to clamp.

The wide finale exposed a planner limit cycle: a chase-runner wedged in chrome sat exactly on the 42px flee threshold, so the hero ran when it got closer, walked back when it didn't, and fired past it for a simulated hour. New pin-shot law: a chaser unmoved for half a second is scenery — walk the lane onto it and take the shot.

smashcheck 575 PASS, full mutant sweep 18/18 (two pre-#2024 anchors retired, host-law mutant added); pilot clears all 9 seeds with three deathless runs; smashplay 28/28 with four new room-9 pixel gates.
Filed QA #2028 for the finale's feel: fan readability on the extra floor and an off-camera cue for boss add spawns.
